voc=json.load(open('/workspace/model/vocab.json'))
def tid(s): return voc[s.replace(' ','Ġ').replace('\n','Ċ')]
def normed(h):
    h=h.astype(np.float32); return h/np.sqrt((h**2).mean(-1,keepdims=True)+1e-6)*g
def load_trace(k):
    z=np.load(f'acts/trace_{k}.npz'); j=json.load(open(f'acts/trace_{k}.json'))
    return z, j
def label_item(tokens):
    """returns list of dict per position: state BEFORE predicting next token (i.e. after consuming tokens[:i+1])"""
    out=[]; text=''; in_code=False; lang=None; seen_def=False; nblock=0; fence_open_pos=None
    for i,t in enumerate(tokens):
        prev_text=text; text+=t
        if t.startswith('```'):
            if not in_code:
                in_code=True; seen_def=False; nblock+=1; lang=None; fence_open_pos=i
            else:
                in_code=False
        elif in_code and fence_open_pos==i-1 and lang is None:
            lang=t.strip()
        if in_code and t in ('def','class') : seen_def=True
        nxt=tokens[i+1] if i+1<len(tokens) else None
        at_line_start = text.endswith('\n')
        st=dict(i=i, tok=t, nxt=nxt, in_code=in_code, lang=lang, seen_def=seen_def, nblock=nblock, line_start=at_line_start)
        # TOP: in python code, at line start, after def seen, next token is column-0 non-whitespace content
        top = in_code and at_line_start and seen_def and nxt is not None and not nxt[0].isspace() and fence_open_pos!=i-1 and lang in ('python','py',None)
        st['top']=bool(top)
        # line start in code generally (incl. indented)
        st['code_ls']=bool(in_code and at_line_start and fence_open_pos!=i-1)
        # block start: right after ```python\n
        st['block_start']=bool(in_code and fence_open_pos==i-2)
        out.append(st)
    return out
